body.text: Aurora Optics reported weak demand and high inventories for 800G optical modules in March 2024, then stated demand exceeded supply in Q3 2026, reflecting a shift from oversupply to supply constraint in that market.

source_memories.text: Aurora Optics stated demand for 800G optical modules exceeded supply in Q3 2026. | When: August 2026 | Involving: Aurora Optics | Indicates supply constraint / demand-supply imbalance for 800G optical modules

Aurora Optics stated demand for 800G optical modules was weak and inventories were high. | When: March 2024 | Involving: Aurora Optics | Indicates weak demand and excess inventory for 800G optical modules, signaling potential supply overhang or reduced near-term orders affecting dependent customers.
